protocol.scope: Existing recorder data, retrospective diagnostic. No random treatment, algorithm attribution, or structural cone interpretation.
protocol.permutation: Fixed-point-free whole-date flow relabelling; longest continuous segment per date; position aligned and truncated to shorter length; comparison mean observed Q; finite simulated rank, not a randomized-treatment p value.
protocol.cone: Negative orthant for observable six-tap regression coefficients, a superset of the negative Hausdorff cone. Gaussian least-favourable vertex simulation with sample date-mean covariance. This is not a finite-sample certificate or a full continuous-cone estimator.
protocol.aggregation: Transition-weighted segment estimates within date, equal-weight dates, Student t interval. Sampled-date independence unproved.
